gloss: to leave early (from work or school)

definitions.gloss: to leave early (from work or school)
definitions.explanation: To depart from one's workplace, school, or an event before the scheduled end time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧{早退|そうたい}した。
examples.english: I left early because I wasn't feeling well.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早退|そうたい}させて⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My child had a fever, so I was allowed to leave work early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}→体調不良：20233_taichoufuryou⟧で⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{早退|そうたい}してしまい、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Last month I left early three times due to poor health, and my boss got worried about me.

notes:
Specifically refers to leaving work or school before the normal end time, usually with permission. Very common in workplace and school vocabulary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早退|そうたい}する: to leave work early
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早退|そうたい}する: to leave school early
- ⟦{早退|そうたい}→早退：05767_soutai⟧{届|とどけ}: early departure notice/form
- ⟦{早退|そうたい}→早退：05767_soutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: reason for leaving early

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}する→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧: to be late — the opposite concept: arriving late rather than leaving early
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be absent from work — not showing up at all
- ⟦{欠席|けっせき}する→欠席する：22283_kessekisuru⟧: to be absent — general absence from a class or meeting
- ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave the office — can mean leaving at the end of the workday or resigning

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese workplaces, {早退|そうたい}する typically requires notifying a supervisor and is often recorded in attendance records. In schools, students usually need a note from a parent or guardian.
